cabinenvironment.cabinregistry.desc: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each cabin environment record

cabinenvironment.cabineqref.desc: A VARCHAR(70) foreign key referencing Equipment(EquipmentCode), linking cabin environment data to a specific piece of equipment

cabinenvironment.cabinlocref.desc: An INTEGER foreign key referencing Location(LocationRegistry), associating this cabin environment with a location or station

cabinenvironment.emergencybeaconstatus.desc: An enum (EmergencyBeaconStatus_enum) indicating the beacon’s mode (e.g., Active, Standby, Testing)

cabinenvironment.ventilationspeedpercent.desc: A DECIMAL(5,2) specifying the current ventilation speed or fan power as a percentage

cabinenvironment.heatertemperaturec.desc: A DOUBLE PRECISION value denoting the set or measured heater output temperature in Celsius

cabinenvironment.defrosterstatus.desc: An enum (DefrosterStatus_enum) describing the defroster’s state (e.g., On, Auto, Off)

cabinenvironment.windowstatus.desc: An enum (WindowStatus_enum) specifying if windows are Open, Closed, or Partial (e.g., Partial, Closed, Open)

cabinenvironment.doorstatus.desc: An enum (DoorStatus_enum) indicating if doors are Locked, Open, or Closed (e.g., Closed, Locked, Open)

cabinenvironment.hatchstatus.desc: An enum (HatchStatus_enum) describing the status of any hatches (e.g., Closed, Open, Locked)

cabinenvironment.cabincommref.desc: An INTEGER foreign key referencing Communication(CommRegistry), linking the cabin environment to a communication record if relevant

cabinenvironment.cabinclimate.desc: JSONB column. Aggregates environmental metrics for the cabin, including temperature, humidity, pressure, and air quality indicators

chassisandvehicle.chassisregistry.desc: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each chassis/vehicle record

chassisandvehicle.brakepadwearpercent.desc: A REAL value measuring the brake pad wear as a percentage of expected lifespan used

chassisandvehicle.vehiclespeedkmh.desc: A REAL number for the vehicle’s current speed in kilometers per hour

chassisandvehicle.tiremetrics.desc: JSONB column. Captures tire-related data, including pressure, temperature, and tread condition

communication.commregistry.desc: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each communication record

engineandfluids.engineregistry.desc: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each engine/fluids record

equipment.equipmentcode.desc: A VARCHAR(50) primary key uniquely identifying each equipment record

equipment.safetyindex.desc: A DECIMAL(5,3) capturing the safety rating index for the equipment

lightingandsafety.lightregistry.desc: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each lighting and safety record

lightingandsafety.externallightstatus.desc: An enum (ExternalLightStatus_enum) indicating external lighting state (e.g., Off, On, Auto)

lightingandsafety.watersupplystatus.desc: An enum (WaterSupplyStatus_enum) indicating water supply condition (e.g., Normal, Warning, Critical)

location.locationregistry.desc: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each location record

location.loceqref.desc: A VARCHAR(70) foreign key referencing Equipment(EquipmentCode), linking location data to a specific piece of equipment

location.latitude.desc: A NUMERIC(9,6) representing the latitude of the location in decimal degrees

location.longitude.desc: A NUMERIC(9,6) representing the longitude of the location in decimal degrees

location.altitudem.desc: A DECIMAL(7,2) specifying the altitude (in meters) above sea level

operationmaintenance.opmaintregistry.desc: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each operation/maintenance record

operationmaintenance.documentationstatus.desc: An enum (DocumentationStatus_enum) indicating if documentation is (e.g., Updated, Incomplete, Complete)

powerbattery.powerbattregistry.desc: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each power/battery record
